field_some_features: Only some of the features have it
operation_copy_nothing: Only points and ways can be copied: not vertices or relations
operation_disconnect_not_connected: This isn't connected to another line or area
operation_square_not_squarish: Its corners aren't close enough to square to be made square
operation_merge_not_areas: Only areas can be merged, and none in a relation
operation_merge_different_tags: Rooms are merged only when they have the same type and levels
operation_merge_not_adjacent: These rooms don't share sides that join them into one
issue_unreadable_level: {key}={value} can't be read. Use numbers like 0, -1, 0.5, lists like 0;1 or ranges like 0-2.
issue_unreadable_level_comma: {key}={value} can't be read. Separate levels with ; (e.g. 0;1) and write decimals with . (e.g. 0.5).
issue_vertical_repeat_on: Stairs and elevators connect levels: list them all in level, not in repeat_on.
issue_door_not_on_wall: This door is not on a wall or room outline, so routing can't go through it.
issue_door_on_wall_area: This door is on a wall drawn as an area. Doors go on wall lines or room outlines, where routing can go through them.
issue_room_not_indoor: room={value} describes an indoor room, area or corridor, but this feature has no indoor=room, area or corridor.
issue_room_on_wall: room={value} on indoor={indoor} says nothing: a wall or column is not a room. Remove room, or move it to the room's outline.
issue_building_part_indoor: building:part is for the 3D shape of a building, not for indoor spaces. Map the space with indoor=* only, or draw the building part separately.
issue_unknown_inside: inside=* is not an established tag. Use level=* to place the feature on a level, and indoor=* for indoor spaces.
issue_door_without_type: indoor=door also needs door=* (the kind of door).
issue_building_passage_level: A building passage runs outdoors through a building: it usually has no level. Use layer=* if it needs one.
issue_opening_on_several_levels: A door, entrance, window or emergency point is on one level: put the lowest in level and the others in repeat_on.
issue_missing_level: This feature is indoors but has no level, so it shows on every level.
issue_outer_door_no_entrance: This door is on the building's outer wall but has no entrance=*, so it can't be found as a way in.
issue_entrance_inside: entrance=* marks a way into the building, but this one is inside it, away from the outer wall.
issue_one_based_levels: This building has no level 0 and indoor features above its {count} levels: are its levels numbered from 1? In OSM the ground floor is usually level 0 (some countries count from 1, keep it then).
issue_non_existent_level: This building's non_existent_levels says level {level} doesn't exist, so it isn't in the level list. Is the level right?
issue_room_on_several_levels: This {indoor} is on levels {level}. A room that really spans them (an atrium, a hall) is right as it is; if each level has its own room here, make one per level.
plan_tool_click_plan_first: Click a spot on the plan first.
plan_tool_measure_on_plan: Click on the plan to measure.
plan_tool_pivot_on_plan: Click on the plan to pick the centre of rotation.
plan_storage_restore_failed: Saved floor plans could not be restored: {error}
plan_storage_save_failed: Floor plans could not be saved in this browser: {error}
plan_storage_blocked: IndoorID is open in another tab with an older version: close that tab, then reload this one.
plan_import_unsupported: IndoorID can import PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG and PDF plans, and plan files (.zip, or .json from earlier versions).
plan_import_map_not_ready: The map is not ready yet.
plan_import_image_unreadable: This image could not be read.
plan_import_image_too_large: This image is too large to import (over 100 megapixels). Scale it down first.
plan_import_svg_unreadable: This SVG drawing could not be read.
plan_import_pdf_unreadable: This PDF could not be read.
plan_file_not_json: This file is not a floor plan file (not JSON).
plan_file_unknown: This file is not an IndoorID or OsmInEdit floor plan file.
plan_file_no_image: A floor plan in this file has no image.
plan_file_damaged: A floor plan in this file is damaged or incomplete.
plan_file_too_large: This floor plan file is too large to open.
plan_file_newer: This floor plan file was made by a newer version of IndoorID: update IndoorID to open it.
login_popup_closed: The login window was closed before you logged in.
login_timed_out: Logging in took too long. Try again.
upload_too_many_changes: {count} features changed: a changeset takes at most {max}. Upload part of your edits first.
upload_not_deleted: OpenStreetMap kept {count} of the features you deleted, because other data still uses them: {ids}. They are back on the map.
drag_moves_features: Moving this point moves {count} features on levels {levels}
draw_point_hint: Click to add a point: on a room's side it becomes a door, on the building's outline an entrance. Escape to stop.
draw_line_hint: Click to add corners. Click the last corner or press Enter to finish; Backspace removes the last corner, Escape stops.
draw_area_hint: Click to add corners. Click the first or last corner or press Enter to finish; Backspace removes the last corner, Escape stops.
